name: stemmix
description: Writes whether this session is working so the stemmix daemon can play one more instrument stem for each working session.

tracks.title: Tracks
tracks.description: How many working sessions it takes to hear the whole song (N). The song plays as 4 stems (drums, bass, other, vocals); k working sessions hear the first ceil(4k/N).

player.title: Player
player.description: Which music app the daemon taps.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: How the song thins out with fewer working sessions. instruments: take instruments away. muffled: keep every instrument and muffle the sound, like through a wall. both: do both.

muffling_max.title: Muffling at fewest sessions
muffling_max.description: How muffled the sound is with no session working, 0 (not at all) to 10 (most). Only in the muffled and both modes.

muffling_min.title: Muffling at most sessions
muffling_min.description: How muffled the sound is when N sessions are working, 0 (not at all) to 10 (most). Only in the muffled and both modes.
